item.title: Parties agreeing to rate of interest cannot later challenge it on ground of public policy: SC upholds 36% interest in BPL-Morgan Securities and Credits case
item.description: BPL Ltd., having knowingly entered into the bill discounting agreement, was bound by its terms. Since it defaulted on repayment for years, the stipulated 36% compound interest could not be considered burdensome or oppressive. The post Parties agreeing to rate of interest cannot later challenge it on ground of public policy: SC upholds 36% interest in BPL-Morgan Securities and Credits case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: From Rule of Law to Cross-Border Justice: Day 1 at the IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium 2025
item.description: Day 1 of the 4th IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium explored key issues shaping India’s legal landscape, including the rule of law, judicial independence, access to justice, and cross-border dispute resolution. The post From Rule of Law to Cross-Border Justice: Day 1 at the IBA India Litigation and ADR Symposium 2025 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: RBI Issues 6 Amendment Directions to Repeal Guidelines on Credit Supply for Large Borrowers – December 2025
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India has repealed the guidelines on enhancing credit supply for large borrowers and issued six amendment directions to strengthen prudential norms, improve bank balance sheets, and enhance regulatory oversight. The post RBI Issues 6 Amendment Directions to Repeal Guidelines on Credit Supply for Large Borrowers – December 2025 appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Delhi HC orders cancellation of copyright registration of edible oil brand ‘NIOP NIWAI’
item.description: “Copyright protection is granted to an artistic work under the Act, only if the said work meets the threshold of originality.” The post Delhi HC orders cancellation of copyright registration of edible oil brand ‘NIOP NIWAI’ appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Legal Metrology Sixth Amendment Rules 2025: New Standards for Evidential Breath Analysers
item.description: Ministry of Consumer Affairs has notified the Legal Metrology (General) Sixth Amendment Rules, 2025, introducing standards for Evidential Breath Analysers. These rules define specifications, features, and compliance requirements for alcohol measurement instruments to enhance public safety and fight alcohol abuse. The post Legal Metrology Sixth Amendment Rules 2025: New Standards for Evidential Breath Analysers appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Failure to record findings on provisional specification vitiates Patent rejection order: Madras HC
item.description: The Court ordered reconsideration of a herbicidal composition patent application. The post Failure to record findings on provisional specification vitiates Patent rejection order: Madras HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: ‘Use of loudspeaker for religious practice ≠ Fundamental Right’; Bombay HC takes suo moto cognizance of recurring noise pollution in Nagpur
item.description: “No religion prescribes that prayers should be performed by disturbing the peace of others nor does it preach that they should be through voice amplifiers or beating of drums.” The post ‘Use of loudspeaker for religious practice ≠ Fundamental Right’; Bombay HC takes suo moto cognizance of recurring noise pollution in Nagpur appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Accessible grievance redressal mechanism; Inclusive education; Mobility aids: SC issues additional directions on rights of disabled prisoners
item.description: The Court directed that directions issued in L. Muruganantham v. State of T.N., 2025 SCC OnLine SC 1444, shall be extended to all the States and the Union Territories, to ensure that the principles are adopted mutatis mutandis within their prison systems as well. The post Accessible grievance redressal mechanism; Inclusive education; Mobility aids: SC issues additional directions on rights of disabled prisoners appeared first on SCC Times.
